sections.heading: Which programme years work online from a Mumbai flat, and which still need a home tutor in the room?
paragraphs: Online works well from Middle Years Programme (MYP) 4 upward and is hardest below MYP 3. The dividing line is not ability, it is whether a student can set up their own desk, open their own folder and keep writing when nobody is sitting beside them. A DP2 student in Vashi usually manages all three. A Primary Years Programme (PYP) 4 student usually cannot, and a parent ends up in the room anyway, which is the point at which an IB home tutor in Mumbai is the calmer and more honest answer rather than a second-best one.

In PYP and the lower MYP years the material itself resists a screen. Number sense is built with physical counters, fractions with cut paper, early reading with a finger on a line. Sessions run thirty to forty minutes before attention goes, and an adult has to be within earshot to restart the task. If a family still wants online for these years, keep sessions short, keep the same time every week, and accept that the adult in the room is part of the arrangement. Home tuition for these year groups asks less of everyone.

From MYP 4 into IGCSE and the Diploma, the structure starts helping. An IGCSE student choosing between Core and Extended Mathematics is choosing between a two-page working habit and a four-page one, which is exactly the decision that makes screen size non-negotiable. A DP student deciding HL or Standard Level (SL) is deciding how much continuous writing the desk has to support: HL History essays and HL Biology data analysis need paper spread out, while SL Economics and SL Business Management survive on a tablet. We ask about those choices at the match stage because they set the kit, the session length and which months will hurt.
bullets: PYP and MYP 1 to 3: short sessions, physical materials, an adult nearby
MYP 4 to 5 and IGCSE: workable online once the desk and screen are fixed
DP1 and DP2: the strongest fit, because the student owns the folder
Core versus Extended at IGCSE changes how much paper the desk needs
HL versus SL changes session length more than it changes the topic list

sections.heading: Subject by subject: the kit an IB and IGCSE student in Mumbai keeps on the desk
paragraphs: Every subject has a short list of physical things that must be on the table, and the sessions that go wrong are almost always the ones where something on that list is in another room. We cover all IB and IGCSE subjects any tutor in Mumbai teaches, and the kit list is the first thing we send a family after the match. It is unglamorous and it is the single highest-return piece of preparation a parent can do in ten minutes on a Sunday.

For Mathematics at either board, that means loose A4 paper rather than a bound notebook, two pencils, a ruler and the graphic display calculator physically in hand. For DP Physics and DP Chemistry, the printed data booklet, a past paper printed rather than opened in a second tab, and a phone propped on a stack of books so a page of working can be shown without the student turning the laptop around. Biology needs blank paper for diagrams. Economics needs paper for diagrams too, because an axis drawn with a mouse takes four times as long as one drawn with a pencil.

For the languages and the essay subjects, the kit is lighter and the microphone matters more. DP English, French ab initio and Spanish B need the text or the stimulus in front of the student on paper, with the same page numbers the tutor has, and a headset so that pronunciation work is not fighting a ceiling fan. IGCSE First Language English and Literature need the set text physically present. Theory of Knowledge (TOK) and the Extended Essay (EE) need the current draft open in the shared folder and nothing else on the screen.

Each of these carries its own internal assessment, and the assessment decides what has to be scannable. DP Sciences carry the Internal Assessment (IA) investigation with its raw data table. Mathematics carries an exploration. Languages carry oral components that need a clean recording, which is a microphone question before it is a teaching question. IGCSE carries coursework in some subjects and none in others. Requests that span all IB and IGCSE subjects and home classes across Mumbai follow the same route, because the assessment calendar, not the format, sets the deadlines.
bullets: Mathematics: loose A4 paper, pencils, ruler, calculator in hand not on screen
DP Sciences: printed data booklet, printed past paper, a phone propped to show working
Economics and Business: paper for diagrams, since drawing axes with a mouse wastes minutes
Languages: the text on paper and a headset microphone for oral components
TOK and EE: the current draft in the shared folder, nothing else on screen
Every subject: one named folder, so the marked script is never hunted for

sections.heading: Across Mumbai: where travel makes online the honest lead and where home tuition still wins
paragraphs: IB online tuition in Mumbai is the honest lead wherever travel, not teaching, is the binding constraint. In South Mumbai, distances are short and the case for online is weakest: a tutor moving between Colaba, Cuffe Parade, Worli and Walkeshwar covers a few kilometres, and even with the Peddar Road and Haji Ali signals in the evening peak, home tuition is usually practical. Tutors here are matched within the island rather than brought down from the suburbs, and the Western Line into Churchgate and Grant Road, Metro Line 3 towards Cuffe Parade and the Coastal Road keep it that way. Online earns its place in South Mumbai for one reason only: a scarce specialism that nobody on the island teaches.

In the Western Suburbs the arithmetic flips. The suburbs run north to south along the Western Express Highway, Link Road, the Western Line and Metro Lines 2A and 7, so Khar West to Santacruz or Malad to Kandivali is easy, while Dahisar to Bandra at six in the evening is not. A Borivali or Juhu family wanting a specific HL Economics teacher based in Bandra is choosing between online and no tutor. In the Central Suburbs, Powai and Chandivali have no station of their own and hang off the Jogeshwari Vikhroli Link Road (JVLR), so tutors arrive by road from Andheri East, Kanjurmarg or Ghatkopar, and Metro Line 1 and the Santacruz Chembur Link Road (SCLR) decide whether a 7pm slot survives the term.

The Eastern Suburbs run from Chembur and Govandi through Vikhroli and Bhandup to Mulund on the Central and Harbour lines and the Eastern Express Highway, with the Eastern Freeway making the island city far closer than the map suggests. Navi Mumbai is a chain of nodes, Vashi, Nerul, Belapur, Kharghar and Panvel, linked by Palm Beach Road and the Sion Panvel Highway, and while the Atal Setu has changed the drive from the island, pulling a tutor across the creek for a weekday evening rarely holds for a full term. Thane spreads from the station across Pokhran Road, Majiwada and Ghodbunder Road, where Kasarvadavali is twenty minutes off-peak and nearly an hour in the peak. For Kharghar, Panvel and the far end of Ghodbunder Road, online is not a compromise, it is what makes a standing weekly slot possible at all. Elsewhere we will happily place a home tutor for all IB and IGCSE subjects in Mumbai if the travel actually works.

sections.heading: What does the Mumbai school calendar do to an online timetable?
paragraphs: The Mumbai international school year starts in late July or August and front-loads its assessment into the months when the weather and the traffic are at their worst. From November to February a DP1 or DP2 student is carrying mock examinations, Internal Assessment drafts, the TOK essay and the EE, often inside the same fortnight. A student at Dhirubhai Ambani International School in BKC, the American School of Bombay, Ecole Mondiale World School in Juhu or Hiranandani Foundation School in Powai is working to a calendar their school sets, and the tutoring timetable has to bend around it rather than compete with it. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any school named on this page.

That calendar is the real argument for online in this city. A session that depends on a tutor crossing the Western Express Highway or the Eastern Express Highway at 6.30pm is a session that gets cancelled in exactly the fortnight it was needed. The week before a mock at Cathedral and John Connon School in Fort, or before an IGCSE coursework deadline at Smt Sulochanadevi Singhania School in Thane or D Y Patil International School in Nerul, is the week a family wants two extra sessions at short notice. Online makes those extra hours findable. It also survives a day when the school is shut for rain and the roads are flooded, which happens most years.

The week around the session matters as much as the session. Mumbai school buses return students between three and five in the afternoon, dinner in most households is between eight and nine, and the usable window for Years 9 to 12 is roughly 6pm to 9pm on weekdays. That window is also when the flat is fullest and the broadband is busiest, which is why the setup conversation is not fussiness. We ask families to protect the same slot every week, to avoid the half hour straight after the bus, and to put the heavier subject earlier in the evening rather than last.
bullets: Term starts late July or August; the first pressure point is October
November to February: mocks, IA drafts, the TOK essay and EE together

Usable weekday window is roughly 6pm to 9pm after the school bus

sections.heading: Home tuition, online and hybrid in Mumbai: the comparison we give parents
paragraphs: Home tuition is still the lead service, and for most students under MYP 4 it is the better one. A tutor in the room sees the pencil stop. They can turn the page, take the calculator away for two minutes, point at the line where the working went wrong, and notice that the student has written nothing for four minutes while looking attentive. None of that is available to an IB online tutor in Mumbai, who sees a video of a face and a document that may or may not be the one the student is writing on. Anyone who tells you the two formats are equivalent has not run both.

What online gives back is real and specific. It removes travel, which is what actually kills consistency in this city: an IB private tutor in Mumbai who loses ninety minutes to the road for a sixty-minute session will eventually start cancelling. It widens the pool from one suburb to the whole city, which is the difference between the right HL Chemistry teacher and the available one. It survives rain, strikes and exam-week rescheduling. Sessions can be shorter and more frequent, which suits IA feedback. And the record is better: the shared folder keeps every marked draft, where a paper notebook in a home class keeps whatever did not get lost.

Hybrid is what most families settle into once they stop treating this as a binary. A common pattern across Mumbai is home classes in the calmer months and online through the monsoon and the exam fortnights. Another is a local home tutor for the main subject and an online specialist for the scarce one. The honest switch-back signal is simple: if three or four weeks have passed and the student still will not write during sessions, still needs an adult to start every task, or is sitting in a room you cannot fix, move to a tutor in the room. We would rather change the format than defend it.
bullets: Home tuition: best for younger years and for students who need supervision to start
Online: removes travel, widens the tutor pool, survives rain and rescheduling
Hybrid: in-person in calm months, online through monsoon and exam fortnights
Online is weakest at noticing disengagement and at managing a chaotic room
Switch back after three or four weeks of no written work in sessions

sections.heading: How tutors are checked, and the setup checks a parent should run
paragraphs: Parents type IB tutors near me in Mumbai and expect distance to be the filter. Online changes the filter to subject depth and availability, which is mostly an improvement, and it means the checking has to be stricter rather than looser. Before a tutor takes a match we verify identity and qualification documents, their teaching record in that specific subject at that specific level, and references from families they have taught. An IB online tutor in Mumbai is checked on one extra thing an in-person tutor is not: their own working setup, because a tutor on an unstable connection wastes your hour whatever their subject record says.

The tutor-side setup check is concrete. We ask what device they teach on, whether they are wired to the router or sitting beside it, whether they use a headset with a boom microphone, what their power backup is, and what they do when their own line drops. A tutor who cannot answer that last question has not taught online seriously. We also ask for a second device, usually a phone, kept charged as a fallback so that audio and the shared file can continue even when video cannot.

There is no single best IB tutor in Mumbai for every student, only a best fit for one subject at one level on one timetable, so the checks a parent runs themselves matter. Ask the tutor to walk you through a marked script from a previous student with the name removed. Listen to the audio in the first five minutes and say something immediately if it is muddy, because muddy audio never improves on its own. Watch whether the tutor asks your child to write rather than nodding along. Ask what their backup plan is, and ask the same of yourself.
bullets: Identity, qualification and subject-level teaching record verified before any match
References from previous families, checked rather than collected
Tutor setup check: device, wired connection, headset microphone, power backup, fallback phone

sections.heading: What does a student need on the desk, and what happens when the line drops?
paragraphs: IB online tuition in Mumbai fails in the room far more often than it fails on the network. The student needs a hard surface at a sensible height, a chair with a back, feet on the floor, and the screen at eye level. A dining table beats a bean bag and a laptop on a bed beats nothing, which is the whole problem: a bed is comfortable enough that it feels fine for six weeks while almost no writing happens. Loose A4 paper and a real pen or pencil go on the table before the session, not fetched during it, and the textbook or data booklet sits open beside the screen rather than in a second tab the student has to hunt for.

Screen size is the constraint families most often get wrong. A thirteen-inch laptop is the realistic floor. A ten-inch tablet is workable for English, French and Economics prose, where the unit of work is a paragraph. A phone is close to unusable for Mathematics and the sciences, and the reason is page geometry rather than processing power: a worked HL Mathematics solution runs twelve to twenty lines, and both tutor and student need the whole thing visible next to the question. On a phone the student scrolls, loses the chain, and starts answering a fragment. The microphone then matters more than the camera. A built-in laptop microphone records the ceiling fan, the pressure cooker and the television at roughly the same level as the student; a headset with a boom microphone fixes most of a Mumbai evening. Video is the first thing to drop when bandwidth tightens, and it should be. Audio is not negotiable.

A stable connection beats a fast one. Forty megabits that drop for eight seconds every few minutes is worse than ten megabits that hold, so run a LAN cable to the router or seat the student in the same room as it, and keep the microwave and the second streaming device off that hour. Then plan for Mumbai specifically. From June to September, treat the laptop battery as the student's power backup and a charged power bank for the router as the connection's, because the router dies the instant the mains do while the laptop keeps going. Building-wide broadband outages after heavy rain or cable work take every flat on the line down at once, so keep a mobile hotspot on a second SIM from a different network, and check the data left on that plan before February and April rather than during them. Noise is the last variable: at 7pm a Mumbai flat has a kitchen, a television, a younger sibling and a doorbell in it, so close a door, and if there is no door, seat the student in a corner facing the wall with their back to the room.

The habits around the session decide whether any of this compounds. One shared folder per subject, shared once, with files named by subject, task, draft number and date, so a Physics IA reads as draft three on the fourteenth of February and not as final_final. The marked script is scanned with a phone and dropped in the folder before the session, never while the tutor waits. The tutor's annotated version goes back into the same folder rather than into a chat thread that scrolls away. A one-page running log records what was covered and what is due. And the drop rule is agreed in week one: if the tutor's line goes, the student keeps working the question for ninety seconds, the tutor rejoins or calls on the phone with the shared file open, and if neither works within a few minutes the next step is posted into the folder and the time is made up. What wastes a session is fifteen minutes of both sides refreshing a browser with no rule to follow.
bullets: Hard surface, chair with a back, screen at eye level, laptop off the bed
Paper and pen on the table before the session starts, not fetched mid-question
Thirteen-inch laptop is the floor; a phone fails for Mathematics and the sciences
Headset microphone beats any camera upgrade; drop video before you drop audio
Wired or router-adjacent beats fast; power bank for the router in monsoon months
One named folder, scans done before the session, a written ninety-second drop rule

sections.heading: What progress looks like at four weeks, one term and one exam cycle
paragraphs: Progress with IB online tuition in Mumbai shows up first as logistics, then as work, then as marks, and in that order. At four weeks the honest measures are mechanical: the session starts on time without a technical fight, the student writes during it rather than after it, a shared folder exists with named files in it, and one specific topic gap has closed. If you are still losing ten minutes a session to audio and file hunting at week four, the setup was never fixed and no amount of subject expertise will compensate.

By the end of a term you should see the student's work changing shape. IA drafts move from outline to data and analysis. Mark scheme language starts appearing unprompted in answers. The number of sessions that begin with I did not understand what the question wanted drops. A parent who sits in for ten minutes once a month will hear the difference before any report card shows it. Over a full examination cycle, criterion-level movement is a reasonable thing to hope for and an unreasonable thing to promise, and IB Gram does not guarantee grades. Tutoring changes the quality and the quantity of practice; it does not change what happens in a three-hour paper.

The limits are worth stating plainly. Online cannot fix a room a family will not change, and it cannot make a student write who has decided not to. It is a poor fit for a child who needs an adult beside them to start a task, which is why we move those students to a home tutor rather than persisting. And setups decay: by week six the laptop has usually migrated back to the bed and the paper has gone missing. We ask parents to re-check the desk once a month, which takes about a minute and prevents the slow slide that makes a perfectly good match look like a failing one.

One term: IA drafts progressing and mark scheme language appearing unprompted

sections.heading: Getting started with IB online tuition in Mumbai
paragraphs: Preparation takes about fifteen minutes and saves a fortnight. Send the board and year group, the subject list with HL, SL, Core or Extended marked, and the device the student will actually use with its screen size. Add a photo of the desk as it will be during sessions, which tells us more than a paragraph of description. Add the most recent marked script, scanned on a phone, and the school's assessment calendar if you have it. Then name two possible weekly slots inside the 6pm to 9pm window and say which one you would defend if something clashed.

The first session follows a fixed shape. The first ten minutes are a setup test: audio both ways, screen share both ways, the folder created and shared, the drop rule agreed out loud. Then the tutor works through one past paper question or one piece of the current IA with the student writing on paper, because that is the only reliable diagnostic. The session ends with three things written into the folder: what was covered, what the student does before next week, and what the tutor will prepare.

If online turns out to be the wrong format, say so early and we will move you. We place home tuition across the city where travel genuinely works, and hybrid arrangements where it works some months and not others. Families in Kharghar, Panvel and the far end of Ghodbunder Road usually stay online because that is what makes a standing slot possible. Families in Worli, Khar West or Chembur often start online for a scarce subject and keep home classes for the rest. Either way, nothing locks you in, and the folder and the room notes follow the student to whoever teaches them next.

faqs.question: Is a phone or tablet enough for IB online tuition, or do we need a laptop?
faqs.answer: A phone is close to unusable for Mathematics and the sciences, and a thirteen-inch laptop is the realistic floor. The reason is page geometry rather than processing power: a worked Higher Level Mathematics solution runs twelve to twenty lines, and the tutor needs to see all of it next to the question. On a phone the student scrolls, loses the chain of reasoning, and starts answering a fragment of the problem. A ten-inch tablet is workable for English, French and Economics prose, where the unit of work is a paragraph. For Physics and Chemistry, borrow a laptop before you book anything.

faqs.question: What happens if the power goes out during a monsoon downpour in the middle of a session?
faqs.answer: The session continues on battery if you have planned for it and stops if you have not. From June to September we ask every family to treat the laptop battery as the student's backup and a charged power bank for the router as the connection's backup, because the router dies the moment the mains go while a laptop at full charge outlasts most outages. If both fail, the tutor switches to phone audio with the shared file open and the clock is paused, with the time made up later in the week. Agree that rule in week one, not during the storm.

faqs.question: Our building broadband goes down for hours after heavy rain. Is a mobile hotspot good enough?
faqs.answer: Yes for audio and a shared document, and no for full video on a weak signal. A hotspot handles voice plus a screen-shared PDF on most Mumbai networks, and video is the first thing that should be dropped when the signal tightens. Keep that second SIM on a different network from your wired provider, because a building-wide outage after cable work or heavy rain takes every flat on the same line down at once and a same-network hotspot can go with it. Check the data remaining on that plan before February and April rather than discovering it mid-session.

faqs.question: Can a home tutor come instead if online is not working for my child?
faqs.answer: Yes, and we would rather move you than defend a format. If three or four weeks have passed and the student still writes nothing during sessions, still needs an adult to start every task, or is below MYP 3, then a home tutor in the room is the honest answer. A tutor sitting beside a student can turn the page, take the calculator away, and see the pencil stop in a way no camera reliably shows. We change the match inside the same term wherever a tutor can reach your area, and the subject folder and room notes transfer with the student.

faqs.question: We live near Kasarvadavali on Ghodbunder Road. Is online our only realistic option?
faqs.answer: Not the only one, but usually the sensible lead. A tutor living near Thane station reaches Kasarvadavali in about twenty minutes off-peak and close to an hour in the evening peak, which means a 7pm slot costs that tutor two hours of road time and tends to get cancelled the first week anything goes wrong. Thane-based tutors cover Thane reasonably well, so home tuition holds up for a common subject taught by someone nearby. For a scarce combination such as HL Chemistry or French ab initio, online removes the travel and protects the standing slot.

faqs.question: What do IB tuition fees in Mumbai depend on for online sessions?
faqs.answer: They depend on board and level, how scarce the subject specialism is, session length, and how many sessions a week you book. The travel component that shapes an in-home rate largely disappears online, which is why a family in Panvel can reach a Bandra-based HL Economics teacher at all. Scarcity does not disappear: TOK support, EE supervision and the smaller languages stay harder to staff than Mathematics or Physics. We do not put a price list on this page because the honest answer is a range that differs by tutor, and you see each tutor's rate on the shortlist before committing.

faqs.question: Our flat in Dadar has four people in it at 7pm. How quiet does the room actually need to be?
faqs.answer: Quiet enough that the microphone is not competing, which usually means a headset rather than a silent flat. A built-in laptop microphone records the ceiling fan, the pressure cooker and the television at roughly the same level as the student, so the tutor spends the hour asking for repeats. A headset with a boom microphone solves most of a Mumbai evening. If there is no door to close, seat the student in a corner facing the wall with their back to the room, which cuts the noise and also removes the temptation to watch what everyone else is doing.

faqs.question: Do we need a printer and a scanner at home?
faqs.answer: A printer earns its place; a scanner does not, because a phone camera does the job better. Printing matters for data booklets, past papers and marked scripts, since students work differently on paper than on a screen and the sciences expect annotated diagrams drawn by hand. For sending work back, a phone photograph taken in a document-scanning app is usually sharper than a flatbed scan and takes seconds. The habit that matters more than the hardware is timing: scan the marked script and drop it in the subject folder before the session starts, not while the tutor sits waiting.

faqs.question: What should my child do if the tutor's connection drops mid-session?
faqs.answer: Keep working the question for ninety seconds, then check the shared folder. Agree this at the first session so nobody panics: the student stays on the problem they were given, the tutor rejoins or calls on the phone with the shared file open, and if neither works within a few minutes the tutor posts the next step into the folder and the lost time is made up. A dropped line is an operational problem with a written answer, not a reason to abandon online sessions. What actually wastes an hour is both sides refreshing a browser with no agreed rule.

faqs.question: My child barely writes anything during online sessions. What do we change first?
faqs.answer: Change the desk before you change the tutor. In most cases the student has no hard surface, no loose paper and no pen within reach, so every instruction to try it yourself turns into a conversation instead of a written attempt. Put A4 paper, two pencils and the open textbook on the table before the session, and move the laptop off the lap and onto a table at a sensible height. If the writing still does not start after two or three sessions with the desk fixed, the format is the problem and a tutor in the room is the fix.

faqs.question: Can we start online and move to home tuition in the same term?
faqs.answer: Yes, and plenty of families run it the other way round too. A common pattern across Mumbai is online through the monsoon and the exam fortnights and home classes in the calmer months. Another is a local tutor for the main subject and an online specialist for the scarce one. Nothing in the match locks you to a format: tell us what changed and we either move the existing tutor to in-person sessions if they can reach your area, or shortlist someone local while the online tutor finishes the current unit of work.

faqs.question: How should we organise files so nothing gets lost between sessions?
faqs.answer: One folder per subject, shared once, with every file named by subject, task, draft number and date. A Physics internal assessment should read as Physics IA draft three with the date on it, not as final_final. Marked scripts are scanned in before the session, the tutor's annotated version goes back into the same folder rather than into a chat thread, and a one-page running log records what was covered and what is due. Families who skip this lose the thread of the feedback within a month, and the tutor spends the first ten minutes of each session reconstructing where things stand.

sections.heading: How does IB Gram match an IB online tutor in Mumbai to your child?
paragraphs: We match on the component, not the subject label. A request for Higher Level (HL) Chemistry help is really three or four different jobs: a student who cannot push electrons through an organic mechanism needs a different tutor from one whose Internal Assessment (IA) methodology paragraph claims a control the raw data never records. So the first thing we ask for is the paper, the criterion and the deadline.

The second thing we ask about is the desk, which sounds trivial and decides the match. If the work is pen and paper heavy, which covers Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry and most of IGCSE Mathematics, the tutor has to be able to watch the student's hand move. That means a phone clamped over the page as a second camera, or a document camera, and a tutor who insists on it rather than merely tolerating it. A tutor working from a photograph of a finished answer is guessing at where the error was, and the error is almost never in the final line. For discussion subjects such as Theory of Knowledge (TOK), History or Economics essays, one camera and a shared document is enough, and pushing a family to buy hardware they do not need is poor advice.

We then run the shortlist past the calendar, because availability is not a detail. A tutor with two free weekday evening slots in October is more useful to a Diploma Programme (DP) student carrying three IA drafts than a tutor with one slot at 9pm on a Sunday. Across all IB and IGCSE subjects and all IB and IGCSE Years 1-12 bands the tutor in Mumbai we put in front of you has taught the component you named and can say what the published criteria reward in it.
The process has no sales call in it.
bullets: 1. Send the subject, level, board, the component in front of you and its deadline.
2. We shortlist tutors who have taught that component, not only that subject.
3. A short first session on your own material, camera on the page, nothing rehearsed.
4. You tell us what you saw; we confirm the slot or re-shortlist without argument.
5. Tutor and student agree the between-session work and how it comes back.

sections.heading: Which IB and IGCSE programmes teach well over a screen in Mumbai
paragraphs: The Primary Years Programme (PYP) is the weakest fit and we say so before anyone pays for a session. A six year old learning letter formation or number bonds needs an adult within arm's reach, and a screen quietly turns a parent into a technician for fifty minutes. Upper PYP reading comprehension and inquiry projects can work online if an adult sits in for the first ten minutes, but online is not the honest lead for early years anywhere in Mumbai.

The Middle Years Programme (MYP) sits in the middle. MYP 1 to 3 students often need a person at the table, especially when the problem is attention rather than content. By MYP 4 and 5 the work becomes criterion driven, Criterion A to D in each subject group, and criteria are text. A tutor can put the MYP Mathematics Criterion C descriptors on a shared screen beside the student's own investigation and show, line by line, which sentence is description and which is justification. The MYP Personal Project supervises well online, because supervision is mostly conversation plus a document.

The Diploma Programme is where a screen earns its place. Higher Level and Standard Level (SL) choices, the Extended Essay (EE), TOK and the IA in every subject are all document work, and document work is what a screen handles cleanly. Past paper marking, mark scheme walkthroughs and essay structure survive the format intact.

IGCSE under Cambridge International Education or Pearson Edexcel brings its own fork: the Core and Extended decision in Mathematics and the tiering in the sciences. That conversation deserves a dedicated session before the school's option forms close, because a student pushed into Extended Mathematics for a university path nobody has checked yet spends two years uncomfortable.

sections.heading: Subject by subject: what the tutor has to be able to see
paragraphs: Subject choice across both boards, the HL and SL split and the Core or Extended tier each carry their own internal assessment, and each of those assessments has a different camera requirement. We cover all IB and IGCSE subjects and every tutor in Mumbai on a shortlist has taught the component you name. Mathematics is the clearest case. In HL Analysis and Approaches the mistake usually arrives by line three, a sign lost inside a chain rule derivative or a bound dropped from a definite integral, and the final answer tells the tutor nothing about which it was. A tutor who can see the pen stops the student mid-line; a tutor who cannot is reverse engineering.

Physics splits the same way. A tutor watching a free body diagram being drawn corrects the missing normal force in four seconds, while a tutor reading the finished numerical answer spends ten minutes discovering it was never there. Chemistry needs arrows, so a mechanism has to be drawn where the tutor can watch it form. Biology is kinder: most of the trouble sits in the data table, the uncertainty column and the statement of the controlled variable, all of which scan cleanly to a PDF and annotate well.

The text subjects need no hardware beyond a screen share. English A Language and Literature Paper 1 is an unseen extract and the session is annotation: tutor and student mark up the same passage live, one colour for the writer's choices and another for the effect being claimed, and the gap between those two columns is the entire lesson. History Paper 1 source work follows the same shape, origin and purpose before content and value. Economics wants the diagram drawn first and the evaluation paragraph written second, in that order, and a screen enforces the order more easily than a kitchen table does.

Oral components are the pleasant surprise. Language B and ab initio individual orals, and the DP English individual oral, rehearse well over a call, because the format is already a conversation about a stimulus sitting on a page.

sections.heading: Mumbai zone by zone, and where online is the honest lead
paragraphs: In South Mumbai, families in Colaba, Cuffe Parade, Walkeshwar, Napean Sea Road and Peddar Road sit close together on the map and far apart in the evening. Eight kilometres from Worli to Colaba can take forty minutes once the Haji Ali and Peddar Road signals load, so an IB home tutor in Mumbai's island city is matched within the island rather than brought down the Western Line or Metro Line 3. Where the subject is scarce, IB online classes in Mumbai are the honest lead, and we will say so rather than stretch a tutor across the city twice a week.

The Western Suburbs run north to south along the Western Express Highway, the Western Line and Link Road, from Bandra and Khar West through Santacruz West, Juhu and Andheri West up to Goregaon East, Malad, Kandivali, Borivali and Dahisar. Matching along the line works; matching across it does not. Metro Lines 2A and 7 have changed the Dahisar to Andheri run and Metro Line 1 makes Andheri to Powai possible, but a 7pm home slot booked with a tutor two suburbs south still becomes a 7:40 start in July.

The Central Suburbs hang off the Central Line and the Eastern Express Highway, with Powai and Chandivali reached by road along JVLR because Powai has no station of its own, while Kurla, Ghatkopar, Vikhroli and Mulund are easier matches. The Eastern Suburbs stretch from Chembur and Govandi through Wadala and Bhandup to Mulund, where the Eastern Freeway and the Santacruz Chembur Link Road put South Mumbai closer than the map suggests.

Navi Mumbai is nodal: Vashi, Nerul, Belapur, Kharghar and Panvel, linked by Palm Beach Road, the Sion Panvel Highway, the Harbour and Trans Harbour lines and now the Atal Setu. We match node to node, because a tutor crossing the creek for a weekday evening lesson rarely lasts a full term, and for a Kharghar or Panvel family needing a scarce HL specialist the screen is simply the better answer. Thane spreads from the station along Pokhran Road, Majiwada and Ghodbunder Road, and Ghodbunder sets the timetable: twenty minutes to Kasarvadavali off peak and close to an hour at 7pm. That one road is why many Thane enquiries settle into online or hybrid. IB Gram works across Mumbai, Maharashtra, and we would rather place a session that starts on time than a tutor who arrives drained.

sections.heading: How the Mumbai school calendar decides what an online session is for
paragraphs: The Mumbai international school year opens in June and that start date sets everything else. A DP1 student who chose six subjects in May spends June and July finding out whether HL Physics was a good idea, which is the one window where a diagnostic session is worth more than any amount of revision. By October the IA drafts begin stacking, and between October and December a DP1 student at a school such as Oberoi International School in Goregaon East or Hiranandani Foundation School in Powai can be carrying a Chemistry IA proposal, a Mathematics exploration outline and the TOK exhibition at the same time.

January and February are mock season, and mocks change what a session is for. A marked mock paper comes back, and the useful hour is not a lesson at all: it is the student reading their own script aloud while the tutor holds the mark scheme on a shared screen and asks, question by question, what the examiner was paying for. Families at Dhirubhai Ambani International School and the American School of Bombay in Bandra Kurla Complex, at Cathedral and John Connon School in Fort, at B.D. Somani International School in Cuffe Parade and at Bombay International School near Babulnath hit that fortnight together, which is also the fortnight when weekday evening home slots across the Western Suburbs are hardest to find.

IGCSE families at Smt. Sulochanadevi Singhania School in Thane, D.Y. Patil International School in Nerul or Ecole Mondiale World School in Juhu work to the May and June series with October and November as the retake route, so their pressure points land a few weeks earlier than the DP calendar. School internal deadlines sit ahead of board deadlines, sometimes by a month, and the internal date is the one the student in front of you is actually frightened of.

IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any of these schools, nor with the International Baccalaureate or Cambridge International Education; we name them because their calendars are what families here plan around. The monsoon deserves its own line. Between June and September a downpour on the Western Express Highway or along Ghodbunder Road cancels a home visit at twenty minutes' notice, and the family already running sessions on a screen keeps the slot while the family that is not loses the week.

sections.heading: Home tuition, online or hybrid: which one does your DP student need?
paragraphs: Start with home tuition if the student is young, easily distracted, or has never had one to one teaching before. A home tutor at the table removes every excuse at once: the phone goes face down, the books come out, and a parent can hear the session from the next room. IB home tuition in Mumbai is what most families ask for first and it remains our lead service. Across all IB and IGCSE subjects home classes in Mumbai run as a standing weekly slot that the society gate learns to expect.

Online wins on three specific things and nothing else. It wins on scarcity, because a student in Panvel or Kasarvadavali can work with a specialist in the subject rather than the nearest available generalist. It wins on time, because nobody should spend forty minutes on the Eastern Express Highway to teach for sixty. And it wins on reliability across a whole term, which matters more than any single session, since IB online tuition in Mumbai is not cancelled by a waterlogged junction. What it costs you is the room: the tutor cannot see the shrug, the pencil hovering, the glance at the door, and a tutor who does not replace that information with technique is teaching half blind.

Hybrid is where most long engagements settle without anyone planning it. One home session a week for the hard teaching, where a tutor can turn the student's own book around and write in it, and one or two sessions on a screen for marking, drafts and past papers. Families near Khar West and Santacruz West often run it the other way: a home session on a weekend morning while the highway is quiet, screens on weekday evenings.

Fees move with the mode, and we would rather explain the levers than quote a number we cannot stand behind. IB tuition fees in Mumbai depend on board, on whether the subject is HL or SL, on how scarce that specialist is, on session length and frequency, and on travel: a home tutor crossing two suburbs twice a week is paid for the road as well as the teaching, which is one reason online and hybrid often come out lower. Group sessions, crash revision blocks before mocks and year long engagements all price differently again.

sections.heading: How is an online IB tutor checked before a Mumbai family books a term?
paragraphs: Before a family is introduced to anyone we check identity documents, the degree or teaching qualification claimed, and the specific experience claimed on the component you asked about. A tutor who says they teach HL Economics is asked which paper, which syllabus edition, and how they would mark a Paper 1 evaluation paragraph. Vague answers end the conversation at that point rather than in your living room.

For an IB online tutor in Mumbai there is a second layer, because a credential says nothing about whether somebody can teach through a screen. We ask to see the setup: camera position, whether they can annotate a PDF live while talking, whether they have a usable second camera or document camera for handwritten working, and what they do with a student who has gone quiet. We also ask what happens when the connection drops, because that answer separates a professional from an enthusiast.

Then check them yourself in the first session, while you still have the standing to do it. Ask the tutor to annotate one page of your child's real work in front of you. Ask which edition of the subject guide they teach from and when first assessment for it was. Ask what the between-session work will be and how it comes back. Ask about recording: who records, where the file sits, who can see it. And watch for the thing no document shows, which is whether the tutor talks for fifty minutes or makes your child produce something within the first ten.

None of this replaces your judgement and we do not pretend otherwise. We can verify what a tutor has done; we cannot verify that they will suit your child. That is why the first session is short, worked on real material, and followed by a conversation with us rather than an invoice.

Recording consent agreed in advance, including who stores the file

sections.heading: The craft of a good online session: show me, do not tell me
paragraphs: The single rule that separates a good online IB session from a bad one is that the student produces and the tutor responds, never the other way round. In a room a tutor reads the body language: the pencil that stops, the nod that came too fast, the shoulder turn that means this has stopped making sense. A screen deletes all of it, and tutors who are good online have replaced it with forced production. Write the first line and read it to me. Put your answer in the chat before I say anything. Share your screen and open the document you actually wrote. What a room gives a teacher for free, a screen has to ask for out loud every few minutes.

That is why the second camera is not a gadget conversation. A phone on an inexpensive gooseneck clamp, pointed down at the page, turns a guessing game into teaching. The tutor sees the integration by parts set up wrongly at the beginning instead of the wrong answer at the end. For a DP1 student in Mulund grinding through HL Mathematics past papers, that difference is the whole hour. A document camera is tidier and a tablet with a stylus tidier still, but the clamp works. What does not work is a photograph of a completed page sent afterwards, because by then the thinking has gone cold and the student can only report what they think they did.

Annotating a draft live is the other thing a screen does better than a dining table. The student exports the Biology IA draft as a PDF, the tutor opens it where both can see it, and they walk the published assessment criteria one at a time: here is where the methodology claims a controlled variable the data never records, here is where the evaluation names a limitation without saying what it did to the result. Talking about an IA in the abstract produces a student who agrees with everything and changes nothing; annotation produces a marked up page that has to be acted on. The same holds for a TOK essay read against its prescribed title, an EE chapter read against Criterion C, and a History essay where the counterargument is simply missing.

Shared whiteboards are where sessions quietly waste time. They are excellent for building something together: a free body diagram, a titration curve, an essay skeleton with the student typing the topic sentences while the tutor pushes back on each one. They are useless when the tutor writes and the student watches, which is a lecture with added latency. The test is crude and it works: across an hour, the student's cursor should move at least as much as the tutor's.

Good tutors also build in silence. Seven minutes of a student working a past paper question with the page camera on while the tutor sits muted, marking the previous question live, is worth more than seven minutes of explanation. Recordings help inside a narrow band. Re-watching a derivation, an organic mechanism or a worked Paper 3 data question works, because the student is re-running a procedure. Re-watching a TOK discussion almost never works, because the value was in doing the talking. If sessions are recorded, ask the tutor to close each one with two or three lines naming what to redo, otherwise the file becomes a comfort nobody opens.

Some components should not be taught this way at all. Practical work is the clearest case: apparatus handling, a titration, anything where the IA depends on data the student collects themselves. The Group 4 project is collaborative by design and loses its point one to one. Early PYP needs an adult in arm's reach. Visual Arts process work and MYP Design prototyping want hands on material. We will tell you when the honest answer is a home tutor, because an IB online tutor in Mumbai who pretends a screen can run a laboratory is selling you something.
bullets: Forced production every few minutes replaces reading the room
Phone clamped over the page beats any photo sent after the session
Live PDF annotation against published criteria, not a chat about the draft
Whiteboard test: the student's cursor moves as much as the tutor's
Silent working blocks with the page camera on and the tutor marking
Recordings help for procedures, rarely for discussion-based components

sections.heading: What progress looks like at four weeks, one term and one exam cycle in Mumbai
paragraphs: At four weeks you should see diagnosis, not transformation. The tutor should be able to tell you in two sentences what is actually wrong: not that your son is weak at Physics, but that he sets up a momentum problem correctly and loses marks on units and significant figures, or that she knows the Economics content and never answers the command term the question used. A good IB tutor in Mumbai will say that plainly by the fourth session, and if nobody can, the match is wrong.

At one term the measurable things move. Past paper scores stop swinging wildly, which matters more than the average rising. IA drafts travel forward through the criteria instead of being rewritten from scratch each time. The student starts using the mark scheme's own vocabulary, which is the quiet sign that teaching has landed. A DP2 student in Chembur or Vashi should by now be able to look at a question and name what it is testing before starting to answer it.

At one exam cycle you find out how much held under timed conditions, which is a different skill from knowing the material. Mocks expose pacing, question selection and whether a 15 mark question gets read properly before the pen moves. The gap between a student's coursework quality and their mock performance is almost always technique, and technique responds to drilling.

The honest limits matter more than the promises. We do not guarantee grades, and anyone who does is not being straight with you. A tutor cannot make a student do the work between sessions, cannot compress two years of missed foundations into six weeks before mocks, and cannot undo a subject choice that was wrong from the start, although they can flag it early enough for the school to be approached. If a tutor is not working out, tell us after two or three sessions rather than at the end of term. We re-shortlist, the handover includes what has already been covered, and nobody asks you to justify the decision.
bullets: Four weeks: a two-sentence diagnosis of what is actually losing marks
One term: past paper scores stabilise and IA drafts move through criteria
One exam cycle: timing, question choice and command-term discipline under pressure
No guarantees: between-session work is the variable nobody else controls
Replacement after two or three sessions, with a handover of ground covered

sections.heading: Starting IB online tuition in Mumbai, or a home tutor if that suits better
paragraphs: Have three things ready and the first session earns its fee. First, the actual material: the marked paper, the IA draft, the teacher's comment, the question that could not be finished. Second, the deadline, because a draft due in nine days and a mock in eight weeks are different jobs with different session shapes. Third, one honest sentence about attention, since a student who cannot sit through fifty minutes on a screen needs home classes instead, and we would rather know that before the session than after it.

The first session is short and diagnostic. The tutor works on your material, with the page camera on if the subject needs it, and spends most of the time watching the student work rather than explaining. At the end you should get a plain summary: what is wrong, what order to fix it in, and what the between-session work is for the coming fortnight.

Setup takes ten minutes, once. A laptop with a browser, headphones so the audio does not echo around the flat, a phone on a clamp if the subject involves working by hand, and a scanner app for drafts. If a tutor spends a third of a first session on configuration, that is a tutor problem and we will replace them. Families searching for IB tutors near me in Mumbai often end up here for exactly that reason: the nearest tutor and the right tutor are frequently not the same person, and IB online tutoring in Mumbai is how you stop choosing between them. If you would rather have an IB private tutor in Mumbai at your own table, say so, and we match on travel as well as on subject.
bullets: Bring the marked paper, the draft, or the question that stalled
Name the deadline; it decides the shape of the first fortnight
Say if attention is the real problem, so we lead with home tuition
Laptop, headphones, and a clamped phone for handwritten subjects
Tell us within three sessions if the tutor is not right

faqs.question: Does an online tutor really work for HL Maths, or does my child need someone in the room?
faqs.answer: It works, but only with a camera pointed at the page. Higher Level Mathematics errors live in the working, usually two or three lines in, and a tutor who sees only a finished answer is reconstructing what happened instead of correcting it as it happens. An IB online tutor in Mumbai who cannot see the pen is guessing. A phone on a cheap clamp over the desk solves this completely. Ask any tutor you trial whether they use a second camera and listen to the answer; one who shrugs at the question will spend your sessions asking your child to narrate their own working, which is slow and unreliable.

faqs.question: What equipment do we actually need for an online IB session?
faqs.answer: A laptop, headphones, and a phone you can clamp over the page. That is the whole list for most subjects. Headphones matter more than families expect, because speaker echo makes a tutor talk over a student, and a student who gets talked over stops volunteering answers. A gooseneck clamp costs very little and turns the phone into a document camera. A scanner app is useful for sending IA drafts as PDFs rather than crooked photographs. A tablet and stylus are pleasant but not necessary. For discussion subjects such as TOK, History or Economics essays, the laptop on its own is enough.

faqs.question: Can a tutor mark my daughter's Chemistry IA draft properly over a call?
faqs.answer: Yes, and this is one thing a screen does better than a home visit. She exports the draft as a PDF, the tutor opens it on a shared screen, and they work criterion by criterion with the tutor marking the document as they talk. She finishes the hour holding an annotated file rather than the memory of a conversation. The ordering is what matters: the tutor should show her where her own evidence fails to support her own claim, not dictate replacement sentences. An IA rewritten in somebody else's voice is an academic honesty problem, and a good tutor refuses to create one.

faqs.question: Are sessions recorded, and does re-watching them actually help?
faqs.answer: Only with your consent, and re-watching helps inside a narrow band. Procedural material is worth revisiting: a derivation, an organic mechanism, a worked Paper 3 data question. Discussion is not, because the learning was in the talking and watching it back is passive. If you do record, agree in advance who stores the file and who can see it, and ask the tutor to close each recording with two or three lines naming what to redo before the next session. Without that, families accumulate hours of video nobody opens and start counting it as revision.

faqs.question: My son is in PYP 3. Is online suitable for him?
faqs.answer: Probably not as the main format, and we will say so before you pay. Early Primary Years Programme learning depends on an adult within arm's reach: letter formation, number bonds, reading aloud, the fine motor work a screen cannot reach. In practice the parent ends up running the session as a technician. For a child this age we lead with home tuition, and we can match a home tutor for all IB and IGCSE subjects in Mumbai from PYP through to DP2. Keep screens for occasional reading comprehension or project sessions where you can sit in for the first ten minutes.

faqs.question: We live in Kasarvadavali on Ghodbunder Road. Is a weekday evening home tutor realistic?
faqs.answer: Realistic only if the tutor already lives along that stretch. Ghodbunder Road at 7pm turns a twenty minute drive from Thane station into close to an hour, so a tutor coming from the station side either arrives late or arrives drained, and either way the slot erodes over a term. We match inside Thane where we can, outward from Majiwada and Pokhran Road. Where the subject is scarce enough that no local specialist exists, a screen session on weekday evenings with one home session on Saturday morning is the arrangement that actually survives a full year.

faqs.question: If we choose a home tutor instead, what should we have ready?
faqs.answer: A gate pass arrangement, a table, and an adult in the flat for the first session. Security in most Mumbai societies needs a home tutor registered as a regular visitor, otherwise fifteen minutes of every sixty minute slot disappears at the gate; ask your committee about standing entry for a weekly tutor. The study space matters more than families expect: a dining table, not a bed, with the television off and siblings elsewhere. For the first session a parent at home is worth it, not to supervise the teaching but to agree the routine and the timings.

faqs.question: What do IB tuition fees in Mumbai depend on?
faqs.answer: Board, level, subject scarcity, session length, frequency and travel. We do not publish a price list, because one number would be wrong for most families. An HL subject with few specialists sits differently from a widely taught SL subject. A sixty minute weekly session and a ninety minute session twice a week before mocks are different commitments. A home tutor travelling from Santacruz West to Borivali twice a week is being paid for the road as well as the teaching, which is why online and hybrid arrangements often come out lower. Crash revision blocks, group sessions and year long engagements all price differently again.

faqs.question: How do you stop my child from just watching the screen for an hour?
faqs.answer: By making him produce something every few minutes, which is a technique rather than a personality trait. A good tutor builds in silent working blocks: the student works a question with the page camera on while the tutor marks the previous one, then they compare. Answers go into the chat before the tutor speaks. The student shares a screen and reads his own sentence aloud. If you listen from the next room and hear the tutor talking for most of the hour, that is the wrong tutor whatever the qualifications say, and we will replace them.

faqs.question: Which IB components do you not recommend teaching over a screen?
faqs.answer: Practical work, the Group 4 project, early PYP, and most hands on Visual Arts or MYP Design process work. Anything where the student handles apparatus or collects their own data needs a laboratory or a table with somebody beside them. A tutor can help design the experiment and interrogate the data afterwards, which is genuinely useful, but the collection itself is school work. Collaborative components lose their purpose when run one to one on a call. For those, a home tutor or the school's own support is the honest answer and we will say so.

faqs.question: What happens if the tutor is not working out after three sessions?
faqs.answer: Tell us and we re-shortlist, with no argument and no explanation required. Three sessions is enough to know whether the student is talking, whether the work between sessions is getting done, and whether the tutor can describe the problem accurately. When we replace a tutor we pass on what has already been covered, so the new tutor does not restart the diagnosis from zero, and we tell them what did not work, which is usually pace or style rather than knowledge. Leaving it until the end of a term is the expensive mistake.

faqs.question: Our building's internet drops in the monsoon. What happens to a session in July?
faqs.answer: It moves to a phone hotspot with audio only, or to a make up slot the same week, and both should be agreed before the monsoon starts rather than during it. Ask a prospective tutor what they do when video fails; the right answer is to switch to voice and keep the shared document open, not to abandon the hour. Across Mumbai, July and August are also when travel based slots collapse: a flooded junction on the Western Express Highway or a stalled Andheri underpass ends a home visit outright, while a screen session usually survives on a mobile connection.

sections.heading: How does IB Gram match a tutor for IB past papers practice in Mumbai?
paragraphs: You send the subject, the level, the examination series your child sits and your area. We shortlist two or three tutors who have taught or marked that subject, and you speak to each one before anything is booked. For IB past papers practice in Mumbai the filter that matters is not who happens to be free on Tuesday. It is whether the tutor can mark a structured response against the published criteria and then say, in one sentence, what the next band needed that this answer did not do.

The request form asks for four things most parents do not expect. Which papers has the child already attempted, and were any of them timed. Whether the school has returned mock scripts with examiner-style annotations on them. Which series the child is entered for, because a May candidate and a November candidate stand at different points in the same calendar year. And where you live, because an IB home tutor in Mumbai who lives in Chembur will hold a 7pm Wednesday slot in Chembur for a full year and will quietly stop holding it in Kandivali by the third month. Distance is not a detail on this city; it is the reason arrangements end.

The first session is a diagnostic and it is deliberately not a lesson. The tutor sets one short topic-sorted question set under timing, marks it in front of the student, and builds the first page of the error log together. By the end of that hour you should hold a written list of error types rather than a percentage. Parents are regularly surprised that the diagnostic exposes a command-term problem rather than a content problem: the child knew the chemistry perfectly and answered a question that said 'explain' as though it had said 'state', which costs marks in every series.

If the match is wrong, say so after the second session rather than the eighth. We ask for the reason in a single line, because 'moves too fast' and 'too gentle with her' lead to completely different replacements from the same subject pool. Home tuition arrangements through IB Gram are agreed month to month for exactly this reason, and a replacement does not restart the diagnostic from zero: the error log travels to the new tutor, which is the main practical argument for keeping one.
bullets: 1. Send the subject, level, examination series and your Mumbai area.
2. Speak to two or three shortlisted tutors before booking anything.
3. Run a diagnostic: one timed set, marked in front of you.
4. Agree a weekly slot and a written error-log format.
5. Review at four weeks against error types, not against scores.

sections.heading: Which IB programme and level your past-paper work should follow
paragraphs: Past-paper practice only means something once you know which course your child is actually entered for. The International Baccalaureate (IB) runs three school-age programmes and they do not all produce papers a family can practise from. The Diploma Programme (DP) in the final two school years is the one with a long public examination record. The Middle Years Programme (MYP) assesses against published criteria and, in schools that opt into it, through on-screen eAssessment, which behaves nothing like a DP paper. The Primary Years Programme sets no examinations at all. Establish the programme, then the level, then the subject. Families who skip that order spend a year practising on material their child will never sit.

Within the DP, Higher Level (HL) and Standard Level (SL) share a subject name and not a component set. The HL course carries additional content and at least one assessment the SL candidate never meets, and in several subjects the question style on a shared paper differs by level as well. Do not take a component weighting, a paper duration or a paper count from a tutor, a forum or a page like this one. The IB revises subject guides on its own cycle, so the only safe sources are the current subject guide for your child's course and your school's Diploma Programme coordinator. Ask the coordinator which components your child sits in which series, and get the answer in writing before you plan practice around it.

Three pieces of DP work cannot be practised from past papers at all. The Internal Assessment (IA) in each subject, the Extended Essay (EE) and the Theory of Knowledge (TOK) essay are judged against criteria rather than against question papers, and running more papers will not move any of the three. An IB home tuition plan that quietly turns into IA drafting has become a different service with a different rhythm, and it should be agreed as such rather than absorbed into practice time. Where a family wants both, we keep them on separate evenings so that neither eats the other.

Command terms are where the level distinction shows up fastest. Each subject guide publishes its own list, and the IB expects 'state', 'outline', 'describe', 'explain', 'discuss', 'evaluate' and 'justify' to be answered at genuinely different depths. A tutor who treats them as synonyms will leave a strong student parked in the middle bands for a year. Ask any prospective IB tutor Mumbai parents shortlist to take one question off a specimen paper and show you what its command term demands that the content alone does not.
bullets: Confirm the programme, the level and the series before buying practice
HL and SL do not sit the same components in most subjects
Ask your Diploma Programme coordinator which papers the course sits
Internal Assessment, Extended Essay and Theory of Knowledge need separate work
Treat the current subject guide as the only authority on structure

sections.heading: What an IB past paper is actually testing, subject by subject
paragraphs: A past paper is not one exercise repeated across the curriculum, and treating it as one is why practice stalls. In Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches and Mathematics: Applications and Interpretation, one paper is sat without a calculator and another with a graphic display calculator, and the formula booklet is part of the assessment rather than a crutch, so a student who has never practised locating a result inside it loses minutes she cannot spare. In the sciences a data booklet does the same job for Chemistry and Physics, and the structured questions reward a stated relationship before any number appears. In English A the unseen analysis paper asks whether a student can build a reading of a text she has never met, under timing, which is the one skill no quantity of class notes supplies.

The pattern repeats across the groups with a different twist each time. History sets a source-based paper where the marks sit in cross-referencing provenance, not in retelling the event. Economics sets data response, where a diagram drawn correctly and labelled carries credit a paragraph of description cannot. Business Management releases a case study ahead of the series, so practice there means rehearsing tools against that case rather than hunting fresh questions. Language B separates listening, reading and writing, and the listening component is the one families almost never practise at home because it feels awkward to sit with headphones on at the dining table. Visual Arts and the performance subjects are assessed through submitted work, so there is no paper to practise and a tutor who offers one has misread the course.

Subject choice across both boards is the decision underneath all of this, and it arrives earlier than most families expect. Whether a child takes a science at Higher Level or Standard Level, whether a Cambridge student sits Core or Extended before moving into the DP, and which Internal Assessment each of those courses carries will shape two years of evening work. A tutor covering all IB and IGCSE subjects tutor in Mumbai families need will usually say plainly that no one person teaches the whole span well, which is the honest answer and the reason we shortlist by subject rather than by board.

Our own listing label for the widest brief reads all IB and IGCSE subjects IB and IGCSE, Years 1-12 tutor Mumbai, and it is not elegant English. What it describes is the range the platform covers across the two boards from the first primary year to the final diploma year, not a claim that any single tutor spans it. When you ask for past-paper work, we narrow that range to one subject at one level with one series in view, because a paper is a subject-specific object and generic practice produces generic marks.

Data and formula booklets are assessed tools, not reference crutches

sections.heading: Where in Mumbai home tuition for past-paper practice actually runs
paragraphs: IB Gram places tutors across Mumbai, Maharashtra, and the geography decides what a weekly timed paper can realistically look like. In South Mumbai the distances are short and the clock is not: a tutor crossing from Worli to Colaba covers eight kilometres and still loses time at the Peddar Road and Haji Ali signals in the evening peak, so we match inside the island, between Cuffe Parade, Walkeshwar, Tardeo and Parel, rather than pulling someone down from the suburbs. The Coastal Road has changed the northbound run more than the southbound one, and Metro Line 3 has made a BKC-based tutor viable for a Cuffe Parade family in a way the Western Line never did.

The Western Suburbs run north to south along the Western Line and the Western Express Highway, which means matching along the line works and matching across it does not. Khar West to Santacruz West is a sane weekly commitment; Malad to Kandivali East is too. Juhu, Bandra West, Andheri West, Goregaon East and Borivali all have deep IB populations, and Metro Lines 2A and 7 have made the Dahisar to Andheri stretch workable for tutors who previously would not cross Link Road at 6pm. In the Central Suburbs, Powai is the exception worth planning around: it sits physically central but has no station of its own, so tutors reach Hiranandani Gardens and Chandivali by road off JVLR from Andheri East, Kanjurmarg or Ghatkopar, and a 7pm slot there means the tutor left at six.

The Eastern Suburbs stretch from Chembur and Govandi through Vikhroli and Bhandup to Mulund West on the Central and Harbour lines, and the Eastern Freeway makes Wadala and Chembur far closer to the island city than the map suggests. Navi Mumbai is planned in nodes, so we match node to node: Vashi, Nerul, Belapur, Kharghar and Panvel are each a short drive from the next on Palm Beach Road and the Sion-Panvel Highway, and the Atal Setu has shortened the island crossing without making a weekday evening lesson from South Mumbai hold for a full term. Thane spreads from the station east across Pokhran Road, Majiwada and Ghodbunder Road, and the Ghodbunder stretch sets the schedule outright: twenty minutes to Kasarvadavali off-peak, close to an hour at seven in the evening. Thane tutors cover Thane; Mulund tutors sometimes cross the Eastern Express Highway and rarely more than once a week.

This is also the honest answer to the searches people actually type. Parents looking for IB tutors near me Mumbai are not asking for proximity as a convenience; they are asking for an arrangement that survives the monsoon and the exam term. For IB past papers practice in Mumbai the practical test is whether the tutor can reach you on the week a whole timed paper is scheduled, when the session cannot be shortened to fit the traffic. We would rather place someone twenty minutes away who holds the slot than a better-credentialled tutor an hour away who starts cancelling in July.

sections.heading: The Mumbai school calendar that decides when whole papers start
paragraphs: Families here deal with a school year that runs from June, a mock season in the cold months and a May examination series, and the gap between those three sets the whole practice plan. Schools such as Dhirubhai Ambani International School in BKC, Ecole Mondiale World School in Juhu, Oberoi International School off JVLR, Aditya Birla World Academy in Tardeo, Cathedral and John Connon School in Fort and NES International School in Mulund West each set their own internal deadlines, and those internal dates, not the IB's, are what your child feels first. IB Gram is an independent platform and is not affiliated with any school named on this page; we name them because their calendars are the pressure points our tutors schedule around.

The practical shape of the year is predictable. June to August is when topic-sorted question sets belong, because the course is still being taught and a whole paper would test material the class has not reached. September and October are when Internal Assessment drafts land in most schools, which is also when past-paper time gets squeezed and should be protected rather than abandoned. November and December carry the mock series in a large share of Mumbai IB schools, and that is the first honest read on timing and stamina. January to March is the stretch where whole papers under full conditions do the most work. April is revision triage, not new learning.

Two calendar facts catch families out every year. The first is that a November-series candidate runs the entire cycle six months out of step with the May majority, so a tutor who plans by the common calendar will have that child doing topic sets when she should be doing whole papers. The second is that the monsoon genuinely interrupts attendance between June and September, particularly on the Ghodbunder Road and JVLR runs and on the Harbour Line, and a plan that assumes forty uninterrupted weekly sessions is a plan that has not been to Mumbai in July. We build the schedule with a spare slot in the week rather than pretend otherwise.

Ask your school's examinations officer for two dates as early as you can: the mock window and the deadline by which the school confirms your child's component entries. Those two dates, held against the subject guide your school is teaching, tell a tutor when to switch from topic sets to full papers. A home tutor who plans against the school's actual calendar rather than a generic revision timetable is doing the part of the job a parent cannot do from the outside.

sections.heading: Should past-paper sessions be home classes or online for a Mumbai student?
paragraphs: Home tutoring is the lead option and for timed papers it has a specific advantage: someone is physically in the room while the clock runs. A paper written at the dining table with a tutor sitting across from it is a paper written without a phone, without a browser tab and without the three unlogged pauses that make a student's self-reported timing meaningless. IB home tuition in Mumbai also solves the supervision problem for working parents, because the adult who enforces the sitting does not have to be you. The honest cost is travel: a tutor crossing the Bandra-Worli Sea Link or coming up the Eastern Express Highway in the evening peak is paying for that in time, and that time shows up in both the fee and the reliability of the slot.

Online is better than home tutoring at two specific jobs and worse at one. It is better for the marking debrief, because a scanned script on a shared screen with a mark scheme beside it is easier to annotate together than a paper passed back and forth across a table. It is also the only realistic route to a scarce subject: a family in Panvel wanting Higher Level Economics or a less commonly taught Language B may simply not have that specialist within an hour, and an IB online tutor in Mumbai solves that where geography cannot. What online does badly is supervise a sitting. A student alone in a room with a camera on will stop the clock, and most do.

Hybrid is what we actually recommend for IB past papers practice in Mumbai once a routine is established. The student writes the paper at home under timing with a parent or an older sibling starting and stopping the clock, photographs the script, and the debrief happens online within forty-eight hours while the reasoning is still recoverable. The home visit then carries the teaching that came out of the marking, usually fortnightly rather than weekly. Families booking all IB and IGCSE subjects home classes Mumbai tutors cover across several children often land here for scheduling reasons alone, because one travelling tutor cannot be in two bedrooms at six o'clock.

There is one mode we argue against. Group past-paper sessions look efficient and are not, because the whole value of the exercise sits in the individual error log. Two students in the same room make the same gross error for different reasons, and a tutor marking both at once will record the error and miss the reason. If cost is the constraint, reduce the frequency of individual sessions rather than share them.
bullets: Home sessions supervise the sitting; that is their real advantage
Online is stronger for marking debriefs and for scarce subjects
Hybrid: write at home under timing, debrief online within two days
Travel across the Sea Link or the highways shows up in reliability
